clarity.method: band-SII-lite: octave bands 250-8000 Hz, per ear SNR of the talker stem vs the rest of the mix (other events + bed), 0.5 s Hann window per 0.1 s frame, audibility clip((snr+15)/30), ANSI S3.5-1997 octave-band importance weights. 'my' = right ear only. 'two' = better-ear listening (max audibility of the two ears per band); it ignores binaural squelch, so it is a conservative two-ear score.
